boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Massachusetts College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations with published late availability, spanning the Fenway/Longwood area and Boston destinations reachable from campus.

cards.title: Tasty Burger Fenway
cards.subtitle: 86 Van Ness St, Fenway
cards.notes: Use the Fenway location when you need a food stop after evening plans; confirm the ordering window before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Fenway burger counter with published daily late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Tasty Burger lists its Fenway location at 86 Van Ness Street as open seven days a week from 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 11:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m., seven days a week; check the business page for changes.

cards.title: Laughing Monk Cafe
cards.subtitle: 737 Huntington Ave, Mission Hill
cards.notes: Plan this Brigham Circle stop for a Friday or Saturday evening meal, and use the restaurant’s location page to confirm service.
cards.short_summary: A Huntington Avenue restaurant with Friday and Saturday service until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Laughing Monk Cafe lists its Mission Hill location at 737 Huntington Avenue and publishes 10:00 p.m. closing times on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published late hours are Friday and Saturday until 10:00 p.m.; other days close earlier.

cards.title: South Street Diner
cards.subtitle: 178 Kneeland St, Boston
cards.notes: Keep this all-night diner as an option for a late meal downtown; order pickup or delivery through the diner’s official site.
cards.short_summary: An all-night diner with official 24/7 pickup and delivery messaging.
cards.evidence_claim: South Street Diner states that pickup or delivery is available 24/7 and identifies itself as open seven nights a week.
cards.access_notes: The official site states pickup or delivery is available 24/7; destination is at 178 Kneeland Street.

cards.title: Black Seed Halal Grill
cards.subtitle: 140 Tremont St, Downtown Boston
cards.notes: For a downtown late meal, use the direct-order page and verify the day’s closing time before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A downtown halal grill with food service published into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Black Seed Halal Grill publishes hours until 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 140 Tremont Street.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: until 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Kaze Shabu Shabu
cards.subtitle: 1 Harrison Ave, Chinatown
cards.notes: Arrange a Chinatown hot-pot meal with time to spare; published hours vary between weeknights and Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Chinatown hot-pot restaurant with service listed through 1–2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Kaze Shabu Shabu lists hours of 11:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11:30 a.m.–2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published late hours: 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Taiwan Cafe
cards.subtitle: Chinatown, Boston
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s own hours page before heading to Chinatown, then allow time for ordering before the 1 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A Chinatown restaurant whose official hours page lists daily service to 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taiwan Cafe’s business-hours page lists 11:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. hours for every day of the week.
cards.access_notes: Published daily hours end at 1:00 a.m.; the business asks guests to call to confirm updates.

cards.title: Peach Farm
cards.subtitle: 4 Tyler St, Chinatown
cards.notes: Use Peach Farm’s direct ordering page for a late Chinatown pickup or meal, and verify availability before traveling.
cards.short_summary: A Tyler Street Chinese restaurant with official hours through 12:30 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Peach Farm publishes opening hours of 11:30 a.m.–12:30 a.m. daily at 4 Tyler Street.
cards.access_notes: Published hours end at 12:30 a.m. every day; online ordering supports pickup and delivery.

cards.title: Canton Eatery
cards.subtitle: 339 Meridian St, East Boston
cards.notes: For an East Boston late meal, check the restaurant’s posted day-specific schedule before beginning the cross-city trip.
cards.short_summary: An East Boston Chinese restaurant with most days listed until 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Canton Eatery publishes hours until 3:00 a.m. Monday and Wednesday–Sunday, with Tuesday listed closed.
cards.access_notes: Published late hours run to 3:00 a.m. Monday and Wednesday–Sunday; Tuesday is listed closed.

cards.title: Capri
cards.subtitle: 500 Harrison Ave, South End
cards.notes: Use Capri for a weekend evening meal in the South End; dinner service ends earlier than the venue’s listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Harrison Avenue restaurant with Friday and Saturday hours until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Capri lists Friday and Saturday hours from noon to 2:00 a.m. at 500 Harrison Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Published Friday and Saturday venue hours end at 2:00 a.m.; listed dinner service ends at 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: New Moon Villa Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 15–19 Edinboro St, Chinatown
cards.notes: Treat this as a Chinatown late-food option and confirm same-day kitchen availability directly before departing from the Longwood area.
cards.short_summary: A named Chinatown restaurant documented with daily service into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: A current Boston restaurant guide lists New Moon Villa Restaurant at 15–19 Edinboro Street with daily hours from 11:00 a.m. to 4:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The cited 2026 guide lists daily service until 4:00 a.m.; confirm directly on the day because restaurant hours can change.
